signal_attribution.reasoning_chain: Positive GEX ($93M) and VIX contango (+8.3%) establish a PINNED regime where dealers are forced to buy dips and sell rips, compressing volatility. This structural support outweighs macro headwinds (30Y yield 5.1%, geopolitical stalemate). Options flow confirms bullish sentiment ($3.64B calls vs $2.02B puts). Intraday signals are highly accurate (87.5%), so confidence is maintained at MEDIUM. Next-day accuracy is historically weak (17.6%), so confidence is reduced and ranges widened to account for weekend gap risk. The convergence of GEX, flow, and regime dictates a bullish mean-reversion bias for intraday and long-term, with cautious bullishness for next-day.
